temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help and says she could definitely use it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria suspects Cheryl is stressed or overwhelmed by the project workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria learns Cheryl is genuinely overwhelmed and welcomes assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl needs and appreciates support with the outreach project.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and gaining confidence. At the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase; the team leader responds positively, and Cheryl accepts while thanking Maria for her confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved, is capable and committed, and may be ready for greater responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria learns the team leader and Cheryl welcome the leadership suggestion, and Cheryl feels ready for the role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready to lead and that recommending her was appropriate and supported.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role for the next project phase.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately and says she wanted to make sure Cheryl felt supported and not pressured. Cheryl responds that she was surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl accepted the leadership suggestion, but she worries Cheryl might perceive the suggestion as overstepping or feel pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria learns Cheryl was surprised but does not feel pressured, and Cheryl values Maria's support and confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings and that Cheryl appreciates her support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry or anxiety, then relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and to maintain trust and a good working relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support. Maria proposes co-leading the project together, and Cheryl enthusiastically agrees, saying Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her honesty and support, and she thinks continuing collaboration through shared leadership could be effective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria learns Cheryl welcomes co-leading and values Maria's guidance; the partnership is mutually desired.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes she and Cheryl can successfully co-lead and support each other as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue their mutual support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria asks about teaming up for more future projects; Cheryl says she would love that and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has grown strong, and she hopes Cheryl is open to more joint projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria learns Cheryl enthusiastically wants to continue working together and shares her excitement about future achievements.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes their partnership is strong and that they will continue to collaborate successfully on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future and continue strengthening their partnership.
